tools.name: notion-search
tools.description: Search the connected Notion workspace for pages and databases by title or content.

tools.name: notion-fetch
tools.description: Fetch a Notion page or database by id or URL. For a database, returns its schema and the pages it holds, each with its id and properties.

id.description: Page or database id or URL

tools.name: notion-create-database
tools.description: Create a new Notion database. Without a parent, it is created as a new private top-level page in the workspace. Returns the new database's id and URL.

parent_page_id.description: Optional page to create the database in

properties.description: The database schema: one entry per property, each {name, type, options?}. Types: title, text, number, select, multi_select, date, checkbox, url.

tools.name: notion-create-pages
tools.description: Create one or more pages in a Notion database. Each page has property values keyed by property name and Markdown content.

tools.name: notion-update-page
tools.description: Update a Notion page: set property values (keyed by property name) and/or replace the page's whole content with new Markdown.

replace_content.description: Markdown that replaces everything on the page

tools.name: notion-move-to-trash
tools.description: Move a Notion page to the trash.
